C_chip_row_wrap.verdict: the row cannot wrap — repeat(6, 1fr) is a fixed 6-column grid. Long labels overflow the chip, they do not add a row.
C_chip_row_wrap.code_comment_discrepancy: EventNew.jsx QTY_CHIPS / SelectChip comments claim 'measured 45.2px per chip' at 375px; measured 44.0px at both 375 and 390, i.e. pinned at SelectChip's touch minWidth:44 floor, not a computed 1fr share.

incidental_findings.detail: The harvest quantity row has a min-content width of 399px (chip grid 6*44 + 5*8 = 304, + 10 gap, + ~50 unit select, + 34 left inset). At 390px CSS width the Unit select's right edge lands at x=399, 9px outside the layout viewport. Identical absolute geometry at 375px width, i.e. 24px outside — the row does not reflow, it clips.
incidental_findings.overlay_effect: Sheet panel becomes horizontally scrollable: scrollWidth 399 vs clientWidth 390.
incidental_findings.fullpage_effect: Chrome expands the layout viewport to 399x863 (from 390x844) to fit the overflow, scaling the whole page down ~2.3%.

incidental_findings.detail: Scroll-position dependent, and both positions are reachable. At 390x500 overlay with the quantity field focused: scrollIntoView block='center' puts the field at 224.7-263.2 and Save at 440-488 — clear. scrollIntoView block='end' (a bottom-aligned scroll) puts the field at 461.7-500.2 against the same Save at 440-488 — the sticky Save paints over the field being typed into. Save passes the aboveFold predicate in both cases; the predicate does not detect this.
